task.description:
Update all documentation to reflect the RELEASED status of EE-12 (Concurrent instance safety).

1. Update docs/status/requirement_status.json for EE-12:
   - status: "RELEASED"
   - implemented_in: ["src/engine/instance.zig", "src/api/routes/tasks.zig"]
   - test_spec: "tests/specs/EE-12.md"
   - test_run: "EE-12-run-01.md"
   - tested_at: "2026-05-22"
   - released_at: "2026-05-22"
   - release_run: "WF02-ee12-20260522"

2. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry under the appropriate version/date heading for EE-12:
   ### EE-12 — Concurrent instance safety
   - Row-level locking (FOR UPDATE NOWAIT) on instance row serialises concurrent operations per instance
   - Two concurrent task completions on the same instance: first succeeds (HTTP 200), second returns HTTP 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION
   - 100 concurrent task completions across 100 distinct instances all succeed with zero cross-instance contention
   - New error variant ConcurrentModification in CompleteTaskError set
   - No schema migration required (existing row-per-instance structure sufficient)

3. Run the retrospective procedure (this run has an estimation.json):
   a. Read handoffs/WF02-ee12-20260522/estimation.json
   b. Compute actual work time per step from started_at/completed_at in each step handoff
   c. Compare estimated vs actual, compute variance_pct per step and overall
   d. If |variance_pct| > 25% for a step, consider whether to adjust docs/metrics/estimation_rules.json
      (only adjust if this is a pattern seen across >= 2 consecutive runs at same difficulty)
   e. Write docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-ee12-20260522.json

4. Set result.status to PASS when all updates are complete.
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json shows EE-12 status as RELEASED
CHANGELOG.md has an EE-12 entry with ConcurrentModification and FOR UPDATE NOWAIT details
result.artifacts_out includes requirement_status.json, CHANGELOG.md, and retrospective file

result.summary: Updated EE-12 to RELEASED in requirement_status.json; added EE-12 CHANGELOG entry (ConcurrentModification, FOR UPDATE NOWAIT); wrote retrospective with 4 D3 rule adjustments (code-designer 9->6, backend-dev 20->7, release-validator 4->2, doc-updater 3->2)
